questions.question: Mohan purchased trousers for Rs. 765, after a discount of 15% was offered on its marked price. What is the marked price (in Rs.) of the trousers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Fraction value of 15% discount = −3/20, meaning Marked Price (MP) = 20 units and Selling Price (SP) = 17 units.

Given SP = 17 units = Rs. 765

1 unit = 765 ÷ 17 = Rs. 45

MP = 20 units = 45 × 20 = 900

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) of trousers = Rs. 765

Discount offered = 15%

**Formula Used:**

MP = SP × [100 ÷ (100 − Discount%)]

 
 Marked Price
 100%

 
 Selling Price
 85% = Rs. 765

 
• 
 

 − 15% Discount

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Marked Price (MP) be 100%.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 100% − 15% = 85%

⇒ According to the question, 85% of MP = Rs. 765

⇒ MP = 765 × (100 ÷ 85)

⇒ MP = 765 × (20 ÷ 17)

⇒ MP = 45 × 20 = 900

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price vs Cost Price

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) while Profit or Loss is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise.

Relationship between MP and CP

If a profit of P% is made after allowing a discount of D%, then the ratio of MP to CP is determined by MP ÷ CP = (100 + P) ÷ (100 − D).

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are offered, the equivalent single discount given is (a + b − a×b ÷ 100)%.
</p

questions.question: In April 2019, Dinesh purchased a new car for Rs. 7,00,000 and sold it in April 2022 at its depreciated cost. If the rate of depreciation in the first year is 20%, 15% in the second year and 10% every year thereafter, what amount of money will Dinesh get as the selling price?
questions.solution:
Given:

Annual depreciation of car value = 20%, 15% and 10%

Cost = 7,00,000

Concept used:

If P is the initial price of the commodity, then after ‘n’ years the value of the commodity will become P × [1 – (n/100)]

Calculation:

Percentage fall in price after 3 years = 700000 × (100 - 20)/100 × (100 - 15)/100 × (100 - 10)/100 

⇒ 700000 × 8/10 × 85/100 × 9/10

⇒ 70 × 8 × 85 × 9

⇒ 428400

**The answer is 428400**

questions.question: In a village election between three candidates, 80% of the voters cast their votes, out of which 3% votes were declared invalid. The winning candidate got 42,680 votes which were 55% of the total valid votes. Find the number of valid votes received by the candidate who stood third, given that he received only 10% of the total valid votes.
questions.solution:
Given:

80% of the voters voted.

3% of the votes are invalid

One candidate got 42680 votes which is 55% of the total valid votes.

Concept:

Invalid votes percent + valid votes percent = 100 percent

Calculation:

Let total voters be 1000x

Number of votes cast = 80% of 1000x = 800x

Number of valid votes = 97% of 800x = 776x

⇒ 55% of 776x = 42680

⇒ 42680x/100 = 42680

x = 100

Valid votes = 776x → 776 × 100 = 77600

The third one received only 10% of the total valid votes = 10% of 77600 = 7760

∴ The answer is 7760.

questions.question: A train starts from a station P for another station Q at 6 p.m. at an average speed of 75 km per hour. Another train starts from station Q for station P at 8 p.m. at an average speed of 105 km per hour. If the distance between these two stations is 690 km, then at what time will the two trains meet?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered by the first train in 2 hours = 75 × 2 = 150 km.

Remaining distance at 8 p.m. = 690 − 150 = 540 km.

Relative speed (opposite direction) = 75 + 105 = 180 km/h.

Time to meet = 540 ÷ 180 = 3 hours.

Meeting time = 8:00 p.m. + 3 hours = 11:00 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance between stations P and Q = 690 km

Speed of the train starting from P at 6 p.m. = 75 km/h

Speed of the train starting from Q at 8 p.m. = 105 km/h

 
•

**Calculations:**

⇒ The first train travels alone for 2 hours (from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.).

⇒ Distance covered by the first train = 75 × 2 = 150 km.

⇒ Remaining distance between the two trains at 8 p.m. = 690 − 150 = 540 km.

⇒ From 8 p.m. onwards, both trains move towards each other.

⇒ Relative speed = Speed of train P + Speed of train Q = 75 + 105 = 180 km/h.

⇒ Time taken to cover the remaining distance = Distance ÷ Relative speed

⇒ Time taken = 540 ÷ 180 = 3 hours.

⇒ The two trains will meet 3 hours after 8 p.m.

⇒ Meeting time = 8:00 p.m. + 3 hours = 11:00 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two objects travel towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects travel in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their speeds (|S₁ − S₂|).

Meeting Time Formula

Meeting Time = Total Initial Distance between them ÷ Relative Speed.
</p

questions.question: Ali, Avtar Singh and Ashok working together can finish a work in 8 days. Ali alone can do it in 20 days and Avtar Singh alone can do it in 24 days. In how many days can Ashok alone do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given**

**Concept used**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation**

Total work = LCM of 8, 20 and 24 = 120 units

Total efficiency = 120/8 = 15 unit/day

Ali's efficiency = 120/20 = 6 unit/day

Avtar's efficiency = 120/24 = 5 unit/day

Ashok's efficiency = 15 - (6 + 5) = 4 unit/day

Time taken by Ashok = 120/4 = 30 days

**The answer is 30 days**

questions.question: If sin α + cos α = (2)/(sqrt3), then what is (tan α + cot α) equal to?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct identity: (sin α + cos α)² = 1 + 2 / (tan α + cot α)

Substitute the given value: (2/√3)² = 1 + 2 / (tan α + cot α)

⇒ 4/3 = 1 + 2 / (tan α + cot α)

⇒ 1/3 = 2 / (tan α + cot α)

⇒ tan α + cot α = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sin α + cos α = 2/√3

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2 × a × b

sin² α + cos² α = 1

tan α = sin α / cos α and cot α = cos α / sin α

**Calculations:**

Squaring both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (sin α + cos α)² = (2/√3)²

⇒ sin² α + cos² α + 2 × sin α × cos α = 4/3

Substitute sin² α + cos² α = 1:

⇒ 1 + 2 × sin α × cos α = 4/3

⇒ 2 × sin α × cos α = 4/3 − 1

⇒ 2 × sin α × cos α = 1/3

⇒ sin α × cos α = 1/6

Now evaluate (tan α + cot α):

⇒ tan α + cot α = (sin α / cos α) + (cos α / sin α)

⇒ tan α + cot α = (sin² α + cos² α) / (sin α × cos α)

⇒ tan α + cot α = 1 / (sin α × cos α)

Substitute the value of sin α × cos α:

⇒ tan α + cot α = 1 / (1/6)

⇒ tan α + cot α = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Trigonometric Identities

sin² α + cos² α = 1, sec² α − tan² α = 1, and cosec² α − cot² α = 1.

Reciprocal Relations

tan α = 1 / cot α, sin α = 1 / cosec α, and cos α = 1 / sec α.

Key Shortcut Formula

The expression tan α + cot α frequently simplifies to 1 / (sin α × cos α), which is a direct and standard substitution for trigonometric simplifications.
</p

questions.question: O is the center of a circle and A is a point on a major arc BC of the circle. ∠BOC and ∠BAC are the angles made by the minor BC on the center and circumference, respectively. If ∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°, then find ∠BOC.
questions.solution:
**Given**

∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°

**Concept used**

The angle subtended by the arc on the centre of the circle is twice that of the angle subtended by the same arc on some point on the circumference.

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/243e0747e4e6f36ce68c36bb2f7919851cbdac845e304cfbffb2aa72e333f14c.png] 

∠ABO = 40° and ∠ACO = 30°

∠ABO = ∠OAB = 40° (opposite angles of the equal sides are equal)

∠ACO = ∠OAC = 30° (opposite angles of the equal sides are equal)

∠BAC = 40 + 30 = 70°

∠BOC = 2 × 70 = 140°

**The answer is 140°.**

questions.question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 8% per annum is Rs. 9120 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 7 years at 8% per annum. Find the sum.
questions.solution:
Given:

The simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 8% per annum is Rs. 9120 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 7 years at 8% per annum

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be P.

​According to the question,

(P × 7 × 8)/100 - (P × 3 × 8)/100 = 9120

⇒ (P × 4 × 8)/100 = 9120

⇒ P = 28500

∴ The sum is ₹28500.

questions.question: If 2x + 3y = 9, and xy = 3, what is 8x³ + 27y³?
questions.solution:
Given:

2x + 3y = 9 and xy = 3

Concept used:

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²)

Calculation:

2x + 3y = 9

on squaring both side we get

(2x + 3y)² = 9²

⇒ 4x² + 9y² + 12xy = 81

⇒ 4x² + 9y² + 12 × 3 = 81

⇒ 4x² + 9y² = 45

now,

8x³ + 27y³ = (2x)³ + (3y)³

⇒ (2x)³ + (3y)³ = (2x + 3y)(4x² - 6xy + 9y²)

⇒ (2x)³ + (3y)³ = 9 × (45 - 6 × 3)

⇒ 243

∴ The answer is 243.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 - 3ab(a + b)

8x3 + 27y3 = (2x + 3y)3 - 3 × 2x × 3y(2x + 3y)

⇒ 9³ - 18 × 3 × 9

⇒ 729 - 486

⇒ 243

∴ The answer is 243.

questions.question: In an isosceles triangle, if the unequal side is 8 cm and equal side is 5 cm, then the area of the triangle is :
questions.solution:
Given:

Length of each equal sides of isosceles triangle = 5 cm

Length of base of isosceles triangle = 8 cm

Formula:

Area of isosceles triangle = [b/4] × √(4a² – b²)

b = base of isosceles triangle

a = each equal side

Calculation:

Area of isosceles triangle = [8/4] × √(4 × 5² – 8²)

⇒ 2 × √(100 – 64)

⇒ 2 × √36

⇒ 2 × 6

⇒ 12 cm²

∴ Area of isosceles triangle is 12 sq. cm.

questions.question: ΔPQR and ΔSQR are both isosceles triangles on a common base QR such that P and S lie on the same side of QR. If ∠QSR = 60° and ∠QPR = 100°, then find ∠SRP.
questions.solution:
**Given**

∠QSR = 60° and ∠QPR = 100°

**Calculation**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a4bfb15335f9b95d71c7df28c4dfb852fc2feb359fa0a086e65af5e2003df24.png] **

In ΔSQR, ∠QSR = 60° and SQ = SR

⇒ ∠SQR = ∠SRQ

∠SQR = ∠SRQ = (180 - 60)/2 = 60°

In ΔPQR, ∠QPR = 100° and PQ = PR

⇒ ∠PQR = ∠PRQ

∠PQR = ∠PRQ = (180 - 100)/2 = 40°

From the given diagram,

∠SRP = ∠SRQ - ∠PRQ

⇒ ∠SRP = 60° - 40°

⇒ ∠SRP = 20°

questions.question: A sum of money is divided among A, B, C in the ratio 3 ∶ 2 ∶ 5, respectively. If the share of C is Rs. 300 more than B, then how much more money will A get than B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum of money is divided among A, B, and C in the ratio 3 ∶ 2 ∶ 5

If the share of C is Rs. 300 more than B.

**Calculation:**

Let the share of money with A, B, and C be 3x, 2x and 5x.

The difference between the share of B and C = 5x - 2x = 3x

⇒ 3x = 300

⇒ x = 100

The difference between the share of B and A = 3x - 2x = x

Since, x = 100, A gets 100 more than B.

**The answer is 100.**
